ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with minimal high-intensity (white) regions localized only to distal tips and singular scratch mark.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface; absence of high-contrast mottling or geometric blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; depth extends approximately 12-15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude irregularities; minor jagged indentation visible on the interior trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge from the notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, thin, curved high-contrast white linear mark located on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized surface trauma appearing as a singular white curved rake/scratch mark on the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation at the fluke tips.
